name: Father
overview: Scripture presents the concept of 'Father' with both reverence and caution, highlighting God as the ultimate Father in heaven to whom all should look (Matthew 23:9). Earthly fathers are called to nurture their children with care and discipline according to the Lord’s guidance, avoiding provocation (Ephesians 6:4), and reflecting God's compassionate heart (Psalms 103:13). The title 'father' also appears in contexts warning against its idolatrous use among priests (Judges 17:10) and forbidding its use as a title among disciples (Matthew 23:9), emphasizing the unique and sacred role of God as Father. Additionally, the phrase 'father of all lies' underscores the spiritual battle over truth, contrasting with the eternal security given by Christ (John 10:28).
